chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū Ayyūb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Wiping the head is upon its front part.”

key_terms.الرَّأْسِ: the head; the body part to be wiped in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.مَسْحُ: wiping; the prescribed act of passing the hand in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.مُقَدَّمِهِ: its front part; the forepart of the head intended for wiping

ai.seo_question: In wudu (ablution), which part of the head should be wiped?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding wudu (ablution), specifying that the wiping of the head is to be performed on its front part. It is a concise juristic statement transmitted from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام concerning the proper manner of ritual purification.
